title: Técnico(a) de implantação i
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Implantação I para atuar no apoio à implantação, instalação e manutenção de sistemas e equipamentos técnicos, contribuindo para a execução das atividades em campo. O(a) profissional será responsável por auxiliar nas montagens, passagem de cabos, instalação de dispositivos, realização de testes básicos e suporte aos técnicos mais experientes, garantindo que as soluções sejam implantadas conforme os padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
Descritivo:
Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, paineis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35).
Instalação e conexão de dispositivos de BMS, Security e SDAI tais como: cameras, sensores, detectores, atuadores, eletroímãs, leitores, módulos e outros dispositivos eletrônicos.
Conhecimento em montagem de RCE, montagem e organização de rack de cabeamento, instalação e conectorização de patch panel, switches e interligação de dispositivos de rede.
Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa.
Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em Qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.
Habilidades:
Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira)
Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone e Terminais elétricos)
Instalação de Dispositivos eletrônicos de BMS, SDAI e SECURITY
Montagem de Rede de cabeamento estruturado (RCE)
Diferenciais: Certificações de fabricantes de sistemas de BMS, SDAI, RCE e SECURITY

title: Project engineer
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Project Engineer para atuar em projetos do setor de óleo & gás e energia, para uma empresa referência no setor.O profissional será responsável por apoiar o Project Manager na coordenação e entrega de escopos específicos do projeto, liderando atividades técnicas, equipes e interfaces, assegurando o alinhamento aos objetivos do projeto, padrões de segurança, qualidade e desempenho.
Responsabilidades
Planejar, organizar, executar, controlar e reportar atividades e pacotes de trabalho sob sua responsabilidade, conforme diretrizes do Project Manager.
Coordenar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares, assegurando clareza de escopo, prazos, responsabilidades e objetivos do projeto.
Garantir comunicação eficaz entre stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo o fluxo adequado de informações para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Desdobrar e comunicar os objetivos e metas do projeto à equipe, assegurando alinhamento e entendimento claro das prioridades.
Gerenciar interfaces técnicas e operacionais entre áreas como engenharia, planejamento, construção, suprimentos, qualidade e HSE.
Identificar riscos, apoiar a definição de ações de mitigação e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos e operacionais, garantindo o avanço das atividades conforme o plano do projeto.
Elaborar e apresentar relatórios periódicos de progresso, riscos, desvios e indicadores ao Project Manager.
Definir, implementar e monitorar planos de ação relacionados ao escopo sob sua responsabilidade.
Atuar, quando aplicável, como representante nominativo do projeto (internamente) e/ou da empresa (externamente) junto a clientes e parceiros.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês fluente.
Experiência mínima de 7 anos em funções similares, atuando em projetos.
Conhecimento sólido e experiência prática em gestão de projetos.
Conhecimento geral em disciplinas como HSE, planejamento, construção, qualidade, engenharia e suprimentos.
Experiência em gestão e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
Vivência em projetos offshore no setor de óleo & gás, como Brownfield, EPC, Flotel, paradas programadas (shutdowns) e projetos de modificação/manutenção.
Experiência em projetos Brownfield será considerada um diferencial.
Certificação PMI ou pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos será um diferencial.

title: Latam-focused research intern
description:
About BCP Securities GroupFounded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.Workplace:Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-siteContract Type:InternshipPosition Description
We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus onLatin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.
The selected candidate must benative orfluent in Spanish and English (mandatory)and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.Please note:Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.Main Responsibilities
· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.
· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.
· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.Requirements
· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).
· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.
· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.
· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.
· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.
· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).
· Clear and structured written communication skills.
· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.Differentials
· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).Benefits
· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.
· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.
· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Azure devops engineer
description: About you You are a senior-level Dev Ops Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You're comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions. You bring to Applaudo the following competencies: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experiencein senior or staff-level Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineering roles. Professional certifications such as Azure Dev Ops, Terraform, or similar (preferred). Hands-on experience with Terraformand automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent). Strong proficiency with Azure services,including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure Open AI. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies(Docker, Kubernetes). Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta. Advanced skills in CI/CD automationusing Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops, and related toolchains. Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, Power Shell, and/or Python. Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams. You will be accountable for the following responsibilities: Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security. Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, Postgre SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability. Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions and Azure Dev Ops. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases. Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability. Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

description:

Requisitos Mínimos Obrigatórios da Função (Eliminatórios):
Escolaridade : Ensino superior completo em Direito. Pós-graduação completa em direito administrativo, direito público ou licitações e/ou contratos.
Experiência Profissional : Sólida experiência em atividades relacionadas à elaboração, análise e acompanhamento de contratos e negociação. Elaboração e revisão de editais; assessoramento e suporte técnico no que se refere a legislação e orientações jurisprudenciais; elaboração de notificação e de avisos de rescisão contratual aos contratados; assessoramento relativo a direitos patrimoniais e morais dos autores com elaboração e/ou revisão de contratos de licença de conteúdo.
Atribuições da função:
Elaborar contratos de bens e serviços (inclui aditivos e termos de apoio/patrocínios), utilizando normas jurídicas, políticas internas e boas práticas de compliance e alinhando necessidades técnicas específicas com as áreas envolvidas e fornecedores - sempre que necessário -, com o objetivo de garantir clareza, validade legal e alinhamento às demandas institucionais.
Negociar renovação contratual, analisando objeto e as cláusulas do contrato, articulando com fornecedores, avaliando propostas, comparando custos, prazos e formalizando acordos, visando melhores condições comerciais e contratuais (ex.: otimização de custos e redução de riscos) em conformidade com a legislação e normativos internos.
Elaborar instrumentos/termos jurídicos (ex.: parcerias e patrocínios/apoios), bem como pareceres, com base em legislação jurídica, normativos internos e boas práticas de compliance, alinhados às necessidades das áreas demandantes e áreas envolvidas (ex.: Jurídico e Finanças), quando necessário, com foco na clareza, validade legal e diretrizes institucionais.
Atender demandas de contratos, articulando com área demandante, Jurídico e Financeiro, participando de reuniões, esclarecendo cláusulas contratuais e prestando orientações sobre normativos internos e procedimentos de contratação (direta ou licitação), legislação e jurisprudência correlacionada, visando alinhamento institucional e conformidade legal que atendam aos orientadores estratégicos.
Atender as contratações relativas a direitos autorais e patrimoniais, mediante análise jurídica da demanda, verificação do enquadramento legal, realização de verificação jurídica “clearance’, interlocução com autores e intervenientes, elaboração dos instrumentos específicos (contratos de edição, cessão, licenciamento, autorizações e declarações), bem como condução de tratativas e negociações, a fim de assegurar a regularização do uso das obras e garantir a conformidade legal e institucional das contratações realizadas pelo Senac DN.
Elaborar e manter atualizados relatórios periódicos sobre contratos ativos e desempenho de fornecedores, utilizando sistemas específicos/ ferramentas de BI e consolidando dados em indicadores e dashboards para fornecer informações importantes e subsidiar tomada de decisão (ex.: identificação de desvios para correção e melhoria de processos).
Avaliar e monitorar riscos contratuais e assegurar aderência às normas legais e regulatórias, aplicando controles internos, participando de auditorias e mantendo registros atualizados, com o objetivo de preservar a integridade institucional e mitigar riscos para a empresa.
Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.

Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, Versa Max, Quick Panel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. title: Senior cost controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller
Location: Barra da Tijuca
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;
Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;
Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;
Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;
Support month-end and year-end closing activities;
Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;
Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);
Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;
Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;
Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;
Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;
Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.
Requirements
Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;
Fluent English;
Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;
Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Bl.

Who we are:
We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.
With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.
About the job:
The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.
Operational Management:
Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Accountable for the P& L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus. 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
Willingness to travel frequently within the region
Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

title: Azure devops engineer
description:
About you
You are a senior-level Dev Ops Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineering roles. Professional certifications such as Azure Dev Ops, Terraform , or similar (preferred). Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent). Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure Open AI. Experience with c ontainerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta. Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops , and related toolchains. Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, Power Shell, and/or Python.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.
You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:
Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, Postgre SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions and Azure Dev Ops. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Analista de inteligência de negócios sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).

Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

title: Technical business analyst
description:
About You
You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.
You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.
You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure Dev Ops, Jira, or similar tools.
Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Full professional proficiency in English. Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.
Qualifications
Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure Dev Ops / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Especialista em finanças de ti
description: Junte-se a uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!      Por que se juntar à TCS? Aqui na TCS, acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença. Por isso, cultivamos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo, repleta de oportunidades de aprimoramento e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias com as ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.        Estamos buscando um  Especialista em Finanças de TI  , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em um contrato  CLT, hibrido  no  Rio de Janeiro - RJ.      Job Description:    O papel do Especialista Financeiro de TI é atuar como um parceiro estratégico entre as áreas de Tecnologia e Finanças, garantindo a eficiência dos investimentos em TI. A missão é implementar a governança de Fin Ops, gerenciar o ciclo de vida financeiro de ativos de TI (Cloud e On-Premise) e assegurar que cada dólar investido em tecnologia gere valor mensurável para o negócio. Este profissional será responsável por modelar cenários de custos, realizar previsões orçamentárias (Budget/Forecast) e liderar iniciativas de otimização de custos em ambientes complexos.      Main Responsibilities    Garantir o alinhamento financeiro:  Assegurar que os custos de projetos e operações de TI estejam dentro do budget aprovado e alinhados com a visão estratégica da empresa.   Validar novos produtos e tecnologias:  Realizar a análise de viabilidade financeira (TCO - Total Cost of Ownership) para novas ferramentas, serviços de nuvem ou contratações de software antes da aquisição.   Análise de Dados e Relatórios:  Executar análises detalhadas de  billing  (faturamento), gerar relatórios de variação orçamentária (Budget vs. Actual) e fornecer insights acionáveis para a liderança.   Integração com Arquitetura:  Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução para estimar custos de futuros projetos e migrações, garantindo  design-to-cost  .   Garantir Escalabilidade e Qualidade:  Assegurar que os modelos de controle financeiro sejam escaláveis para acompanhar o crescimento da nuvem e mantenham padrões de auditoria/compliance rigorosos.   Transferência de Conhecimento:  Apoiar equipes técnicas com expertise corporativa em finanças, educando engenheiros sobre o impacto financeiro de suas decisões técnicas.      Requirements and Competencies     Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)    Inglês Fluente (Mandatório):  Comunicação verbal e escrita avançada para reportar-se a stakeholders globais.   Fin Ops & Cloud Cost Management:  Experiência comprovada em gestão de custos em nuvem (Azure/AWS), incluindo  Reserved Instances  ,  Savings Plans  e  Tagging Strategy  .   Contabilidade de TI (IT Controlling):  Domínio de conceitos de CAPEX vs. OPEX, depreciação de ativos e alocação de custos ( Chargeback/Showback  ).   SAP ERP:  Conhecimento sólido nos módulos financeiros do SAP (FICO, PS - Project Systems) e integração com compras (MM) para rastreio de pedidos de TI.   Ferramentas de BI e Excel:  Excel Avançado (VBA/Macros é um plus) e Power BI para construção de dashboards financeiros automatizados.   Experiência Sênior:  Mínimo de 5-8 anos em funções financeiras, com foco específico em Tecnologia da Informação ou Telecom.      Soft Skills    Comunicação e Influência  : Habilidade excepcional de comunicar conceitos financeiros complexos para públicos técnicos e vice-versa (Tradutor Técnico-Financeiro).   Visão Estratégica  : Capacidade de pensar no "big picture", alinhando decisões de corte ou investimento de custos com os objetivos de longo prazo da companhia.   Resolução de Problemas (Problem Solving):  Perfil analítico e proativo, engajado em identificar "vazamentos" de orçamento e propor soluções criativas para eficiência.   Colaboração e Liderança:  Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares (Engenheiros, Arquitetos, Compradores) e capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo.    Organização e Foco  : Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas prioridades (fechamento mensal, planejamento anual, controle diário) em um ambiente dinâmico.      Differentials / Nice to Have:    Certificações Fin Ops:   Fin Ops Certified Practitioner  (FOCP) é um grande diferencial.   Conhecimento de Arquitetura Enterprise:  Entendimento de como decisões de infraestrutura afetam a estrutura de custos (ex: Serverless vs. VM).   Ferramentas de Gestão de Custos:  Experiência com ferramentas de mercado como Apptio, Cloud Health ou Azure Cost Management nativo.   Métodos Ágeis:  Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/SAFe) e como adaptar o planejamento financeiro tradicional para ciclos ágeis (Lean Budgeting).   Automação:  Noções de Python ou Power Shell para automatizar a coleta de dados de faturas ou integração de APIs de billing.    Negociação:  Experiência prévia em negociação direta de contratos de software (Enterprise Agreements) com grandes vendors (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP).      Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:    Governança Orçamentária Estratégica  : Assegurar que as necessidades de negócio estejam alinhadas à visão financeira, gerenciando o ciclo completo de planejamento (Budget), previsões (Forecast) e controle de realizado (Actuals) para garantir a saúde fiscal dos departamentos de TI.   Viabilidade Financeira e TCO  : Validar financeiramente novos produtos, serviços e tecnologias antes da aquisição, desenvolvendo estudos robustos de TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) e ROI (Return on Investment) para suportar decisões de arquitetura e compras.   Gestão de Fin Ops e Cloud Economics  : Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução e engenheiros para implementar práticas de Fin Ops, identificando desperdícios, otimizando o consumo de nuvem (Azure/AWS) e garantindo a eficiência do custo por transação/unidade.   Visibilidade e Análise de Dados Financeiros  : Realizar análise de dados complexos e estatísticas de consumo para gerar dashboards executivos que traduzam o "technês" em indicadores financeiros claros, permitindo transparência e cobrança interna (Chargeback/Showback).   Garantia de Escalabilidade Econômica  : Assegurar que os modelos financeiros suportem a escalabilidade técnica, garantindo que o crescimento da infraestrutura não resulte em explosão de custos não planejada e mantendo padrões de qualidade e compliance financeiro.    Liderança e Cultura Financeira  : Suportar times técnicos e outros arquitetos com expertise corporativa financeira, promovendo uma cultura de responsabilidade de custos (accountability) e documentando processos para transferência de conhecimento.         <<<< Anexe seu currículo em inglês>>>>>>        O que oferecemos? Isso se aplica a gênero, pessoas com deficiência, LGBTQIA+, religião, raça e etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são baseadas nesses princípios. Pensamos em diferentes ações de inclusão e responsabilidade social para construir uma TCS que respeite cada pessoa. Nosso lema é “Inclusão sem exceção”. Junte-se a nós e torne-se um TCSer!     RGS:

Experiência em aplicar IA em processos criativos para ganho de produtividade e qualidade.

Providenciar comunicações de rádio e, quando necessário, qualificações do sistema de gestão de pessoal da embarcação.

Experiência prévia na função
Experiência em funções administrativas (Purser);
Conhecimento de Excel;
Inglês avançado;
MCIA, GMDSS, CNS14, LPNA com histórico de renovação, CHT (carteira da LPNA válida), CBSP e THUET

title: Fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Outlet de Ouro trabalha com peças em ouro 18k de segunda mão e joias de grandes grifes e alto padrão, em um processo que se inicia com compra de ouro, passa pela manutenção das joias em oficina e termina na exposição e venda das peças via Instagram e E-Commerce. (@outletdeouro).
Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer para algumas funções mistas, mas todas interligadas no processo da loja. A necessidade que identificamos é ter alguém conosco pelo menos 2 dias na semana, uma vez que temos como demandas principais o seguinte: 1. Tirar fotos e vídeos de mais de 50 novas joias por semana, incluindo diferentes ângulos para a mesma joia; 2. A fotografia e gravação de videos profissionais em estúdio com nossas modelos usando algumas das peças e 3. A criação de conteúdo criativo mobile, como stories de Instagram e Trends de Tiktok, de forma que a criatividade e proatividade são também fundamentais. OBS: 1 desses 2 dias de trabalho da semana é exclusivamente separado para as fotos das joias como no estilo atual do nosso feed, que o candidato pode buscar no Instagram para entender. Isso ocorre pois o fluxo de peças é muito grande e para além de Instagram também trabalhamos com grupo de Whats App. O cargo possui horário e dias flexíveis, que serão combinados semanalmente, mas as atividades são em sua maioria presenciais no Rio de Janeiro, principalmente nos nossos escritórios do Recreio dos Bandeirantes e Barra da Tijuca.
Qualificações Fotografia e Edição: Experiência em técnicas fotográficas, composição e edição de imagens utilizando programas como Adobe Photoshop e Lightroom. De preferência experiência semelhante com vídeos. Organização e Planejamento: Habilidade em planejar cronogramas de sessões fotográficas e gerenciar o tempo de maneira eficaz.
Experiência prévia em fotografia de produtos e editorial com modelos é essencial.

title: Especialista em infraestrutura

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced life support and emergency care training;
Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;
Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.

Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

Realizar as atividades de vendas corporativas, planos e iniciativas de gestão e relacionamento comercial com clientes diferenciados com médio impacto financeiro, realizando prospecções e ofertas, entendendo necessidades realizando contatos e visitas para mapeamento e/ou monitoramento da qualidade e grau de satisfação dos produtos adquiridos da Seguros Unimed, buscando e avaliando informações que permitam a criação, atendimento a novas demandas e promoção de alterações em contratos/condições comerciais e/ou no desenvolvimento/produção de produtos, assegurando nível de satisfação e continuidade de contratos;

Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed;
Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações;
Realizar vendas de produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados;
Manter cadastro de clientes atualizado, bem como manter-se informado do potencial e situação financeira dos mesmos;
Identificar novas demandas externas, quais as necessidades e o potencial do mercado, desenvolvendo novos clientes e buscando continuamente novas oportunidades de negócios para a empresa;
Promover e fortalecer a imagem da empresa no mercado, cumprindo a estratégia e plano de ações de marketing, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de divulgação e disseminação dos produtos, soluções e marca, monitorando efetividade das ações mercadológicas;
Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
Acompanhar o desempenho do mercado e da concorrência, procurando conhecer os produtos e a similaridade dos mesmos com os produtos da empresa.;
Participar ativamente de programas de melhoria da qualidade dos produtos, serviços e meio ambiente, cumprir as normas internas e de segurança do trabalho;
Prestar suporte aos clientes e parceiros, no que se refere às peculiaridades da empresa, contribuindo com a melhoria dos serviços a serem prestados;
Buscar a geração de novas oportunidades, mediante identificação dos pontos que podem ser trabalhados no cliente, imaginando e propondo soluções;

Controlar reclamações de clientes, fazendo follow-up na área competente para retorno e devolução rápida, bem como acompanhar a resolução de problemas internos do pós venda;
Elaborar relatórios de vendas, especificando os resultados obtidos e mantendo o superior hierárquico informado sobre o andamento das vendas, volume de vendas e tendências futuras do mercado;
Cumprir o regulamento interno, normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, bem como as observações dos requisitos de compliance, observação e o cumprimento das regulamentações atinentes à empresa;
Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência;

title: Mechanical design engineer (oil & gas - subsea)
description:
Fast Dolphin is an international staffing company with over two decades of experience specializing in recruiting bilingual and multilingual IT experts across the Americas and providing payroll and customized staffing solutions. Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.
Recruiting a Bilingual Mechanical Design Engineer (Oil & Gas – Subsea) for a project in a Technology Company. Resumes to
Mechanical Design Engineer (Oil & Gas – Subsea)
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (100% Onsite)
Duration: Long-term
Work Model: Full-time
Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer with strong experience in Oil & Gas subsea equipment design to support ongoing offshore and EPCI-related projects in Rio de Janeiro.
Although contracts are structured annually due to procurement requirements, this is a long-term opportunity within a strategic subsea engineering environment.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in mechanical part and assembly design , particularly in deepwater subsea applications , and must be comfortable working 100% onsite.
Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical parts and assemblies for subsea and offshore equipment. Support EPCI and Installation Aids projects for offshore operations. Perform detailed 3 D modeling and 2 D drafting using Solid Works (or similar CAD tools). Ensure designs comply with manufacturing, safety, and offshore operational standards . Apply GD& T principles in mechanical drawings and technical documentation. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (engineering, fabrication, installation, commissioning).
Support installation feasibility and structural adequacy in offshore environments.
Contribute to cost reduction, operational efficiency, and safety improvements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
7+ years of experience in Mechanical Design Engineering. Proven experience in Oil & Gas subsea equipment design (deepwater preferred). Strong background in mechanical part & assembly design . Proficiency in Solid Works (3 D modeling & 2 D drafting) . Solid understanding of GD& T . Experience working in offshore or subsea environments.
Availability to work 100% onsite in Rio de Janeiro .
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with deepwater subsea systems (e.g., WCT, VCM, TH, PLET, PLEM, UTA).
Exposure to EPCI projects and offshore installation support.
Experience with SAP or engineering documentation systems.
Advanced English

title: Sales & trading intern
description:
Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.
Sobre a BCP DTVM A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.
Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.
Local de Trabalho : cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial Tipo de Contrato : estágio
Principais Responsabilidades:
Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos).
Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias.
Apoiar a equipe de Sales no atendimento a demandas de clientes institucionais, family offices e investidores profissionais, incluindo envio de cotações, informações de mercado e materiais de suporte.
Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações.
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e “market updates” (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos.
Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/No Me/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos.
Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação.
Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e automação de rotinas (Excel/VBA/Python, quando aplicável).
Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes.
Requisitos:
Cursando graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
Interesse genuíno por mercado financeiro, especialmente renda fixa, crédito privado e macroeconomia local.
Excel intermediário/avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, organização de bases).
Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil organizado.
Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional para interação com áreas internas e clientes.
Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com agilidade e priorização em rotina de mesa.
Disponibilidade para estágio presencial na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Ipanema).
Diferenciais:
Conhecimento básico de produtos de renda fixa (duration, curva, spread, marcação a mercado).
Familiaridade com Bloomberg e/ou plataformas de negociação.
Noções de VBA, Python, Power BI ou automação de relatórios.
Inglês intermediário/avançado.
Benefícios:
Bolsa Estágio
Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa global com forte atuação no mercado de renda fixa.
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.

title: Data architect (data modeling & optimization)
description:
About You
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
Strong proficiency using Git Hub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Sales executive - subsea
description:
About M&O PartnersM&O Partners is a multi‑disciplined professional services company providing sales development, strategic and operational services to the energy and maritime industries, with a strong presence in Brazil’s offshore market. From Rio de Janeiro, M&O supports international subsea and offshore technology providers in winning new business with Brazilian operators, EPCIs and contractors through local technical sales expertise and structured sales representation.Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Subsea is responsible for driving M&O Partners’ commercial development within the Brazilian subsea market, with a primary focus on acquiring new customers and opportunities for M&O’s supplier portfolio of subsea equipment, systems and digital solutions.
Reporting directly to the Senior Advisor – Subsea, the Sales Executive - Subsea will proactively identify prospects, open doors at target accounts, progress opportunities through the sales cycle, position M&O’s supplier portfolio and develop new client relationships with offshore operators, subsea contractors, and engineering companies.
The Sales Executive - Subsea will engage with key stakeholders across the Brazilian subsea value chain, providing technical insight and solution‑driven support to ensure client needs are met, supplier value is clearly articulated, and sales objectives are consistently achieved.
Success in this role is measured by new logos, qualified pipeline creation, closed new business and sustained satisfaction across M&O’s subsea supplier portfolio.Key ResponsibilitiesNew Business Hunting & Development
Proactively research, identify and prioritize target accounts in the Brazilian subsea ecosystem, including E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and engineering consultancies.
Execute structured outbound prospecting (calls, emails, Linked In, events) to secure first meetings with decision‑makers and influencers in engineering, operations, and supply chain.
Open and quality new relationships (“new logos”) for M&O in the subsea market, convert leads into commercial opportunities and manage the full sales process from prospecting to contract closure, handing over matured accounts for farming when appropriate.
Expand M&O’s reach among key players in the subsea market, ensuring ongoing engagement and account development.Product & Solution Representation
Develop a strong technical understanding of subsea products and services in the M&O portfolio, including equipment, systems, intervention technologies and software used in subsea operations and integrity management.
Lead initial discovery and capability meetings, presenting supplier solutions and tailoring the value proposition to Brazilian subsea project needs.
Coordinate deeper technical discussions with supplier specialists while maintaining commercial ownership of the opportunity.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier innovations, certifications, and subsea industry standards.Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor Brazilian subsea project pipelines, pre‑salt developments, brownfield tiebacks and intervention campaigns to time outreach and proposals effectively with M&O’s supplier portfolio (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs).
Map competitive offerings and routes‑to‑market, identifying white space and differentiation angles for M&O’s supplier portfolio.
Provide structured insights on projects, competitors and customer requirements to the Senior Advisor - Subsea and M&O’s supplier portfolio to refine targeting and positioning.Sales Process & Reporting
Support the development of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives for the subsea market.
Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, logging activities, contacts, opportunities, next steps and realistic pipeline forecasts.
Monitor proper use by M&O’s supplier portfolio in the subsea market of our CRM tool.
Report regularly to the Senior Advisor - Subsea on number of new leads and first meetings, pipeline volume and quality, stage progression and new business closed.Skills and Competencies
Technical Sales Expertise: Proven success in B2 B sales of technical/engineered solutions in subsea, offshore, SURF or related industrial environments.
Client‑Facing Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise value propositions for Brazilian subsea stakeholders at multiple levels.
Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable navigating Brazilian procurement processes, RFQs and tenders, and supporting commercial negotiations for high‑value contracts.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Uses market data and project intelligence to prioritize accounts, design prospecting campaigns and focus on highest‑potential opportunities.
Autonomy & Collaboration: Self‑starter who plans and executes their own hunting activities while closely aligning with the Senior Advisor and the Sales teams.
Language skills: fluent Portuguese and advanced English.Experience Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience within the subsea industry (ideally serving the Brazilian SURF market) with an active network of professionals.
Minimum 2 years of B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within subsea, offshore or engineered equipment sectors.
Demonstrated track record in outbound prospecting, generating new business and closing new accounts (not only managing existing ones).
Experience engaging with E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and intervention/service companies in Brazil.
Solid understanding of project‑driven, longer‑cycle sales and formal procurement environments and technical sales environments.

Advanced English

Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciências Atuariais, Estatística, Finanças, Economia, Seguros, Resseguros ou Engenharia.

title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales
